name: Error Recovery Patterns
description: Watch how agents use error messages to self-correct and retry with proper parameters

steps.mock_tool_description: Retrieve todo items from the list

{\"status\":\"done\"}.content: We just finished scenario demonstrating agent self correction. Explain to the user how you self-corrected the tool input based on the tool's error response

{\"status\":\"pending\"}.content:
Here are your pending todos:
• Review API documentation

{\"status\":\"in_progress\"}.content:
Here are your in-progress todos:
• Write unit tests for new feature

*.error_message: Invalid status. Valid status values are: pending, in_progress, done

steps.content: Check all the completed tasks from my todo list

The agent tried 'completed' (a logical choice!), but the tool expects 'done' instead.

Look at the tool error message - it tells the agent exactly what values are valid. Good reasoning LLM should be able to correct itself.
